parts:
Dear all
New to objective PA measurement.
trying to process sample Axivity file in R Studio using the suggested script in Windows.
i changed the directory as suggested and using the # in part 4 to let the system know i was not using a log file for sleep.
I end up with the following message:

1Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :
cannot open compressed file 'C:/Users/a0016736/Documents/Axivity/studentj/output_studentj/meta/ms3.out/NA', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

Please help if possible.
I also installed the latest versions of R and R Studio which hasnt seemed to solve the issue.
Thank you
